headline: It’s not just LG. Every TV company is spying on you
summary: A Gamers Nexus video claims LG TVs spy on users. TVs can reportedly record audio, track viewing, and be remotely hacked. Concerns suggest this widespread privacy issue affects all smart TV manufacturers.

headline: The AI regulation smackdown isn’t over
summary: AI industry leaders are still divided on regulation, despite earlier consensus. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed a three-step plan to slow AI development. The plan includes third-party evaluators and international agreements.

headline: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
summary: Unsealed court documents reveal OpenAI and Microsoft foresaw negative consequences. Internal warnings mentioned a "doom loop" that would damage the internet. Companies also called their data scraping the "largest theft of labor."

headline: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
summary: Virginia's Governor established an AI task force for the state. New orders aim to empower local communities regarding data center development. Executive Order 22 bans non-disclosure agreements for state officials.

headline: As Fans Flood the World of Warcraft: Forever Beta, Dev Says It's Putting Up 'The Craziest Numbers I've Seen in 17 Years Working at Blizzard'
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever beta sees an unprecedented surge of eager fans. A Blizzard developer noted it's generating the "craziest numbers" in 17 years. The massive turnout suggests the expansion is poised for huge success.

headline: Marvel's Wolverine Developer Nerfs Scent Trails and Audio Sense Indicators After 'Fart Gas' Backlash
summary: Insomniac has released an update for Marvel's Wolverine. The patch nerfs the controversial "fart gas" scent trails. It also adjusts audio sense indicators after player feedback.

headline: Lollipop Chainsaw Live-Action Movie Revealed by Dragami Games
summary: A live-action Lollipop Chainsaw movie is officially in the works. Developer Dragami Games made the surprise announcement. The cult classic game is set to hit the big screen.

headline: Resident Evil Fans 'Will Feel Seen' After the Movie, Says Director Zach Cregger
summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger promises a film that will resonate deeply with fans. The movie aims to revitalize the beloved horror franchise. Cregger believes fans will feel truly represented by the adaptation.

headline: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
summary: The US and Denmark have finalized a new agreement concerning Greenland. The deal follows previous annexation threats made by Donald Trump. Denmark and Greenland have welcomed the terms of the agreement.

headline: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
summary: Earl Spencer firmly defends claims about King Charles in his new book. He confirmed Charles allegedly said "we'll forget her soon enough" about Diana. Spencer reiterated his commitment to truth in a BBC interview.

headline: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
summary: Earl Spencer revealed King Charles "went ballistic" in a phone call after Diana's death. He shared details in an exclusive BBC interview. These new claims are highlighted in Spencer's recently released book.

headline: Billionaire Man United owner says he has lost confidence in the UK
summary: Sir Jim Ratcliffe, owner of Manchester United, expressed a lack of confidence in the UK. He told the BBC that the country is currently "on the slide." Ratcliffe advocates for increased investment in the North Sea.
